verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that connects Statsig to AI clients such as Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code, so agents can query experiments and Statsig data. It also ships a separate Docs MCP server at /api/mcp, and a probe confirmed the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: detailed setup/authentication and tool-list documentation in the evidence, clarity on whether the server supports write actions (e.g., creating or modifying gates), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
